title: Stovetop
description: A cooking simulation set in a detailed 3D kitchen. Make popcorn, eggs, pancakes, spaghetti aglio e olio and a pan-seared steak on a gas hob where the heat, oil, water and flame are all simulated.
how_to_play: Tap to open, then use the mouse to pick up ingredients and tools and to work the hob. The cookbook in the kitchen has the recipes; nothing else tells you the steps. Best with sound on.
